liebermann.description_de: Verlorene Vorlage von H und Rl für CHn cor, Wl art und In Cn
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of H and Rl, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.laws: CHn cor, Wl art, In Cn
liebermann.notes: An early-12th-century common source of H and Rl for CHn cor (cf. Harley 1757), Wl art and In Cn, posited by Liebermann; for In Cn he derives it from hd.

entries.text_de: Verlorene Vorlage von H und Rl für CHn cor (vgl. Harley 1757), u. S. 521, Wl art, u. S. 486, und In Cn u. S. 612. Für In Cn aus hd.
entries.text_en: Lost exemplar of H and Rl for CHn cor (cf. Harley 1757), below, p. 521, Wl art, below, p. 486, and In Cn, below, p. 612. For In Cn derived from hd.

transcription.doubts: No comma after the second 'In Cn' as printed. The final 'In Cn' is roman.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): O’Brien argues that Rl was copied from H, so for the Instituta there was no hrl.
